asym_knee_rom.label: Knee range difference, left vs right
asym_knee_rom.sentence: How differently the two knees move. Healthy walking is close to symmetric; one-sided OA is not.
asym_knee_rom.high_means: one knee is doing much less work than the other

asym_knee_mean.label: Left-right difference in knee bend — average
asym_knee_mean.sentence: How different the two sides are in how far the knee flexes and straightens (average). Healthy walking is close to symmetric.

asym_knee_max.label: Left-right difference in knee bend — most bent point
asym_knee_max.sentence: How different the two sides are in how far the knee flexes and straightens (most bent point). Healthy walking is close to symmetric.

asym_knee_min.label: Left-right difference in knee bend — straightest point
asym_knee_min.sentence: How different the two sides are in how far the knee flexes and straightens (straightest point). Healthy walking is close to symmetric.

asym_knee_corr.label: Left-right knee coordination
asym_knee_corr.sentence: How closely the two knee-angle traces mirror each other through the walk.
asym_knee_corr.high_means: the legs move in a coordinated pattern
asym_knee_corr.low_means: the legs have fallen out of step with each other

asym_hip_rom.label: Left-right difference in hip swing — range of movement
asym_hip_rom.sentence: How different the two sides are in how far the thigh swings forward and back (range of movement). Healthy walking is close to symmetric.

asym_hip_mean.sentence: How different the two sides are in how far the thigh swings forward and back (average). Healthy walking is close to symmetric.

asym_hip_corr.label: Left-right difference in hip swing — corr
asym_hip_corr.sentence: How different the two sides are in how far the thigh swings forward and back (corr). Healthy walking is close to symmetric.

asym_ankle_rom.label: Left-right difference in ankle angle — range of movement

asym_knee_rom_ratio.label: Knee range ratio (worse / better)
asym_knee_rom_ratio.sentence: The worse knee's range divided by the better knee's. 1.0 is perfectly symmetric; lower means one knee is far stiffer.
asym_knee_rom_ratio.low_means: one knee is markedly stiffer than the other

var_knee_L_sampen.label: Left knee stride predictability
var_knee_L_sampen.sentence: How repeatable the left knee's bending pattern is from stride to stride.
var_knee_L_sampen.high_means: the knee pattern wanders between strides
var_knee_L_sampen.low_means: the knee repeats the same pattern each stride

var_knee_R_sampen.label: Right knee stride predictability
var_knee_R_sampen.sentence: How repeatable the right knee's bending pattern is from stride to stride.
var_knee_R_sampen.high_means: the knee pattern wanders between strides
var_knee_R_sampen.low_means: the knee repeats the same pattern each stride

var_ankle_sep_sampen.label: Stride predictability
var_ankle_sep_sampen.sentence: Sample entropy of the stride pattern — low means each stride closely repeats the last, high means the pattern wanders.
